verdict.rationale: Weave documents an agent-driven eval loop. Its evaluation API and `Evaluation` object take a `Dataset` plus scorers (docs-6, docs-19, docs-47). Coding agents using W&B Skills and the MCP server can "run evaluations" on their own (docs-20, docs-45, docs-57), and the MCP server gives agents direct access to evaluation data to answer questions (docs-44, docs-56). REST endpoints in the Service API add further programmatic access (docs-15). Missing for 10: explicit docs on programmatically creating/publishing a standalone dataset, detail on the result read-back API beyond MCP Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
